style:
This is an EDIT of attached image 1, not a new drawing. Reproduce attached image 1 as faithfully as possible: the same canvas size and aspect, the same number of figures/frames in the same order and positions, the same character design, body poses, limbs, hands, clothing, weapons, wings, tail, effects, colors, line weight, brush texture and rendering style. Do not redesign, restyle, re-pose, mirror, crop, add or remove anything.
The ONLY change: the character is fighting an enemy who stands off-canvas to the RIGHT. In every figure whose face is visible, turn the head slightly toward the RIGHT (a three-quarter view facing right) and move the eyes and irises so the character looks at the RIGHT edge, toward the enemy, never at the viewer or camera. Keep the same facial expression (smile, grit, wince), the same face design and hair. Leave figures whose eyes are closed or whose face is hidden or already looking right exactly as they are.
_note: 戦闘中の主人公がカメラ目線になっていたコマを、目線と顔の向きだけ右 (敵側) に直す。refs の gaze_src/*.png は元の raw (tools/codex_art/raw/ は git 管理外) のコピー
